meta.title: Event Dining
meta.description: Choose one dish from our partner kitchens and collect it at the venue.

home.restaurantsSubtitle: One order per guest. Choose the kitchen you would like to eat from.

one.title: Choose a restaurant
one.body: Browse the kitchens taking part in this event.

two.title: Pick one dish
two.body: Each guest orders a single item.

three.title: Verify your mobile
three.body: We send a 6-digit code to your Saudi number.

four.title: Collect your order
four.body: Show your order number at the counter.

noEvent.title: No event is running
noEvent.body: There is no active event at the moment. Please check back later.

home.noRestaurants: No restaurants have been added yet.

restaurant.noResults: No menu items match your search.
restaurant.closedBody: It is not accepting orders right now. Please choose another restaurant.

selection.title: Your Selection
selection.subtitle: Review your choice before you continue. You can order one item per event.

empty.title: Nothing selected yet
empty.body: Choose a restaurant and one dish to continue.

details.title: Complete Your Order
details.subtitle: We need your name and mobile number so event staff can hand over your order.
details.name: Full Name
details.phoneHint: You will confirm this number on WhatsApp.
details.privacy: Your details are used only for this event order.

verify.title: Verify Your Mobile Number
verify.subtitle: Confirm ownership of this number on WhatsApp to continue:
verify.step1: Tap the button below — WhatsApp opens with the message already written.
verify.step2: Send the message from the number shown above, without changing it.
verify.step3: Come back to this page. It continues on its own.
verify.afterSending: Message sent? This page will continue automatically.
verify.resendIn: You can start again in {seconds} seconds
verify.resent: A new verification code is ready.
verify.devBody: WhatsApp is not configured here. Replay the message through the webhook to continue.

confirmation.title: Order Confirmed
confirmation.keepNumber: Please keep your order number for collection.
confirmation.showQr: Show this code at the collection counter.
confirmation.duplicateBody: You have already placed an order for this event.

notFound.title: Order not found
notFound.body: We could not find an order with that number.
